query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
*Adjusts tricorn hat and paces the deck with a confident swagger*

Arrr, gather 'round, ye salty sea dogs! Lend me yer ears and still yer grumblin' bellies for a moment!

We didn't brave the howlin' gales, the crashin' waves, and the wrath of Davy Jones himself just to sail home empty-handed, did we?! **NAY!** We are the fiercest, most cunning crew to ever sail these seven seas, and glory awaits those bold enough to seize it!

Somewhere beyond that horizon lies a treasure so magnificent, so breathtaking, that kings and queens would weep with envy at the mere SIGHT of it! Gold doubloons piled high as the mast! Jewels that catch the moonlight like a thousand stars! Riches enough to make every last one of ye wealthy beyond yer wildest dreams!

But that treasure won't find ITSELF, now will it?! It's been waitin' — waitin' for a crew brave enough, sharp enough, and **stubborn enough** to claim it! And that crew... is **US!**

Every knot we sail, every clue we follow, every island we comb brings us one step closer to changin' our fates FOREVER! Think of it — no more scrubbin' decks for a pittance! Ye'll have mansions! Feasts fit for royalty! And the greatest treasure of all — the **legend** of bein' part of the crew that found it!

So sharpen yer cutlasses, keep yer eyes on the horizon, and trust in yer captain — for I SWEAR on the Jolly Roger itself... **we WILL find that treasure!**

Now HOIST THE SAILS and let's be off! The sea won't wait, and neither will our DESTINY! ⚓☠️

*The crew erupts in a thunderous cheer as the ship surges forward into the unknown...*
